status: Reviewed percentage riders of the representative models (owner decision 64, 2026-11-24). Each entry quotes the official text that says what the percentage applies to. Treatments: 'apply' prices the rider as its percentage of the charges named by 'base' (base charges only, never other riders); 'exclude' keeps a percentage of the whole bill or of revenues billed disclosed but not applied; 'subsidy' is an automatic percentage rebate, left out of the cost before subsidies and applied only in the after-subsidy figure while its component dates are in force (data/models/subsidies.json). The engine requires a reviewed entry for every percentage component of a territorial (YT, NT, NU) record: a percentage component without one makes that record not computable. Provincial percentage adjustments stay disclosed and not applied; there are no provincial entries.
rule: An entry matches a component of a record of its utility when match.component_name_regex (and, when given, match.tariff_code_regex) fully match. Base: the record's priced charges whose component names fully match base.component_name_regex, at the usage level (percentage riders never apply to each other). A 'subsidy' entry may name the 'apply' riders whose share of the base it also covers (with_riders) and a monthly kWh limit, which must equal the component's published threshold.
